page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.32-256 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the AMD EPYC 7J13 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The instance allocates 32 dedicated physical cores supporting 64 virtual central processing units (vCPUs) with simultaneous multithreading at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz. System memory totals 256 GB, reflecting an even 4 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for standard enterprise resource footprints.

The hardware configuration includes zero discrete GPUs and does not bundle local NVMe or solid-state disk storage. As a result, operating system persistence and application data storage rely on network-attached block storage services. Networking includes one complimentary public IPv4 address assigned directly to the instance for ingress and administration.

With its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated compute allocation, the instance provides steady multithreaded capacity without CPU neighbor contention. The primary trade-off is the total absence of local scratch disks, requiring deliberate block storage provisioning for I/O-sensitive pipelines. The instance profile aligns with multi-tier enterprise applications, web serving backends, container orchestration nodes, CI/CD runners, and relational database systems.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.32-256 is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7J13 processor running at 2.55 GHz. Configured with 32 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, it pairs substantial parallel computing capability with 256 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance features no local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for system and application persistence, and contains no discrete GPU accelerators. Networking includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute performance without thread contention from neighboring tenants. Given its balanced resource footprint and high core density, this server is suitable for medium to large-scale enterprise applications, web application backends, container orchestration nodes, relational database servers, and distributed compilation workloads.
